title: Drash in Pursuit
description: Beginning at city hall, the pursuit leads all throughout the streets of Mos Espa. Cutting tight corners and smashing through the streets, the citizens of the city evade the chase. Drash heads up a staircase on her grav scoot, riding on the roof and coming off the edge, she lands on top of the majordomo's landspeeder, causing him to lose control and spin out. Now cornered by Drash, the majordomo has nowhere to run. Boba Fett jets in and demands to know where the mayor is. "He's with the Pykes. He's working with the Pykes!" the majordomo reveals.
